facts.text: The invitation is on behalf of the North American Telugu Society (NATS).
The event is called America Telugu Sambaralu.
America Telugu Sambaralu is being held at NJ Expo Center.
NJ Expo Center address is 97 Sun Field Ave, Edison, NJ.
America Telugu Sambaralu is scheduled from May 26 to May 28, 2023.
North America Telugu Society (NATS) is a non-profit national organization representing Telugu speaking people of North America.
NATS primary objective is to address issues and concerns that affect the everyday lives of Telugu people living in North America.
America Telugu Sambaralu is a NATS biennial national conference.
The conference is a three-day event.
The conference includes star-studded cultural programs.
The conference includes literary and spiritual activities.
The conference includes CME sessions.
The conference includes Zellenial (Next generation group) programs and activities.
The conference includes alumni meetings.
The conference includes health forums.
The conference includes Women’s forum.
The conference includes motivational speeches and business seminars.
The conference provides a platform to exchange ideas and interact with each other.
The conference celebrates a rich cultural heritage.
NATS basic principle is “SERVING THE COMMUNITY”.
More information about the conference can be found at http://www.sambaralu.org/.
NATS is arranging to celebrate 100 years of Sri Ghantasala garu on May 26, 2023.
NATS is arranging to celebrate 100 years of Sri Allu Ramalingaiah garu on May 27, 2023.
NATS is arranging to celebrate 100 years of Sri NTR garu on May 28, 2023.
NATS planned several literary sessions including Ragavadhanam.
The invitation letter is to Telugu film director Sekhar Kammula.
